orgName: The University of Texas MD Anderson Cancer Center

source.name: Houston Dynamo FC – 'Houston Dash and Houston Dynamo FC Extend Agreement with The University of Texas MD Anderson Cancer Center'
source.quote: today announced a three-year sponsorship extension that started in 2019 aimed at continuing their collaborative efforts to end cancer
source.note: No deal value has been reported. The club's original announcement (https://www.houstondynamofc.com/news/md-anderson-houston-dynamo-team-one-goal-end-cancer) says that 'Effective Jan. 1, MD Anderson is the official cancer center and jersey partner' and calls it 'the first season-long cause-related jersey partnership in MLS history'; the 2024 release adds that 'The Dynamo jersey has prominently featured MD Anderson's logo for seven consecutive years'.
